newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Battle for Swedish mortgage bank hots up.
newsitem.headline: Battle for Swedish mortgage bank hots up.

text.p: Swedish high street bank Handelsbanken was set on Thursday to bid for mortgage bank Stadshypotek, challenging Swedish insurer Skandia's bid.
Handelsbanken said it would hold a news conference at 1500 GMT concerning Stadshypotek. Brokers said it appeared certain the bank would reveal a competing bid to Skandia's, made last month.
Swedish high street bank Svenska Handelsbanken is Sweden's largest bank in the country by asset size with a significant market share in both corporate and retail banking.
U.S. credit rating agency Standard & Poor's last week upgraded Handelbanken's outlook to positive from stable.
Skandia's bid for Stadshypotek angered the Swedish government, which holds 34 percent of the mortgage bank.
Finance Minister Erik Asbrik said no decision would be announced on a sale of the state's stake until an auction process was completed.
